verdict.rationale: Rollbar has a documented REST API reference (rollbar-docs-14, rollbar-docs-15) listing endpoints and example calls, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable-example interface (e.g., a live sandbox or 'try it' console); probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404s, suggesting no interactive spec-driven reference. Missing for 10: evidence of a live/interactive API console, runnable code examples, or an OpenAPI spec backing the reference.
